purpose: Source-aware guard and focused one-request repair probe for first-mount prop-derived state in an inline child
new_guard_scope: Only named inline Vue child objects with props and a data() field whose initial expression reads this.prop, matched to a same-named San inline component. Require initial this.data.get(prop) and this.data.set(field) before a watcher in inited(). Other source shapes are left unassessed.
next_step: Execute the frozen one-request repair probe, then freeze and audit its result before any fresh development batch.
